related.title: 雙循環地熱發電系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「有效溫差與實際效率」與「冷水管的泵功」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；雙循環地熱發電系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Effective temperature difference and real efficiency" and "Pumping power for the cold-water pipe" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Binary Cycle Geothermal Power Systems must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦只有二十度溫差可用的熱機：有效溫差、海水流量、熱交換面積、污垢與泵功；雙循環地熱發電系統則以用七十幾度的溫水發電：冷源的重要、工質壓力比、工質流量、泵功與取代的柴油為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A heat engine with only twenty degrees to work with: effective temperature difference, seawater flow, exchanger area, fouling and pumping; Binary Cycle Geothermal Power Systems centres on generating from water at seventy-odd degrees: the cold sink, working-fluid pressure ratio, fluid flow, pump work and diesel displaced, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「海水溫差與所需流量」與「熱源溫度與效率上限」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「熱交換面積」的模型移到雙循環地熱發電系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「工質泵的耗功」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Ocean thermal gradient and required flow" and "Source temperature and the efficiency ceiling".
Move the model of "Heat-exchange area" to Binary Cycle Geothermal Power Systems, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Work of the feed pump", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「有效溫差與實際效率」與「冷水管的泵功」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；雙循環地熱發電系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Effective temperature difference and real efficiency" and "Pumping power for the cold-water pipe" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Binary Cycle Geothermal Power Systems must be respecified.

related.title: 振盪水柱波浪發電系統
related.titleEn: Oscillating Water Column Wave Energy Systems
related.transfer: 可遷移「有效溫差與實際效率」與「冷水管的泵功」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；振盪水柱波浪發電系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Effective temperature difference and real efficiency" and "Pumping power for the cold-water pipe" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Oscillating Water Column Wave Energy Systems must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦只有二十度溫差可用的熱機：有效溫差、海水流量、熱交換面積、污垢與泵功；振盪水柱波浪發電系統則以用海浪推動空氣、再用空氣推動渦輪機：波浪功率、氣流速度、威爾斯渦輪機與波壓為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A heat engine with only twenty degrees to work with: effective temperature difference, seawater flow, exchanger area, fouling and pumping; Oscillating Water Column Wave Energy Systems centres on waves pushing air and air driving a turbine: wave power, air speed, the Wells turbine and wave pressure, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「海水溫差與所需流量」與「波浪功率通量」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「熱交換面積」的模型移到振盪水柱波浪發電系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「水柱的自然週期」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Ocean thermal gradient and required flow" and "Wave energy flux".
Move the model of "Heat-exchange area" to Oscillating Water Column Wave Energy Systems, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Natural period of the water column", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「有效溫差與實際效率」與「冷水管的泵功」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；振盪水柱波浪發電系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Effective temperature difference and real efficiency" and "Pumping power for the cold-water pipe" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Oscillating Water Column Wave Energy Systems must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 海水溫差發電熱交換器
history.titleEn: Ocean Thermal Energy Conversion Heat Exchangers
history.text: 1881 年海水溫差發電的構想被提出；1979 年夏威夷的小型試驗首次淨發電；2013 年沖繩久米島示範電廠啟用；2015 年夏威夷示範電廠併網。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 1881: The idea of ocean thermal energy conversion was proposed. 1979: A small trial in Hawaii first produced net power. 2013: The Kumejima demonstration plant in Okinawa opened. 2015: The Hawaii demonstration plant was connected. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
